tool_input.description: List classes referenced in cli2 package-summary via simple grep (python blocked, fallback to grep)

result:
Compiled successfully. I created three self-contained JUnit (3.8-style, `junit.framework.TestCase`) test classes based strictly on the javadoc contracts in `api/`:

- `tests/org/apache/commons/cli2/WriteableCommandLineAgentTest.java` — exercises the `WriteableCommandLine` interface contract (add/get option, value, switch, property, current-option, `looksLikeOption`) using `WriteableCommandLineImpl` as the only known implementing class, including the documented `IllegalStateException` on re-adding a switch and the "defaults don't leak into undefaulted values" guarantee.
- `tests/org/apache/commons/cli2/commandline/WriteableCommandLineImplAgentTest.java` — tests the concrete class's documented methods (`hasOption`, `getOption`, `getOptions`, `getOptionTriggers`, `getValues`, `getSwitch`, `getProperty`/`getProperties`, `toString`, current-option), using the "none null" and fallback-to-default guarantees from its javadoc.
- `tests/org/apache/commons/cli2/option/GroupImplAgentTest.java` — tests `GroupImpl`'s constructor-derived state (description, minimum/maximum, preferred name), the `isRequired` min/flag interaction explicitly called out in its javadoc, `getOptions`/`getAnonymous` boundary cases, and `validate`'s documented `OptionException` on breaching the minimum/maximum member counts.

Since the only documented concrete `Option` implementation available in `api/` is `GroupImpl` itself, it's reused as the fixture "option" throughout (avoiding any reliance on undocumented library internals). `./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK` (one harmless unchecked-operation note from raw-type collections, consistent with the library's pre-generics API).
